name: Spotlight Restaurant & Bar
description: Spotlight Bar and Grill is a lively karaoke venue renowned for its friendly atmosphere, diverse song selection, and vibrant live music nights. It offers a smoke-free environment with friendly staff and a cozy, neighborhood vibe. The venue features a full bar, delicious food options including burgers, shrimp salads, and steaks, and hosts karaoke almost every night of the week, making it a perfect spot for fun, food, and entertainment.
